description: verify.add refused as a shape error because its params name an identity key: the actor is stamped by the daemon from the CONNECTION (the kernel's peer credential, the door's ActorFor seam) and never read from params (VG18's actor rule) — a param that names it would let a caller forge the audit identity of a write to their own data. The refusal happens before the seam is even asked, and the same rejection guards all six verify writes, the rule's two writes and the DoD mark.

error.message: invalid params: verify.add params carry "actor" — the actor is stamped by the daemon from the connection, never named by the caller
